context: Yumiko and Sho plan a holiday visit.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (女の子/ママ/老人/休日/神様) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、次の休日はどこ行く?
lines.en: Mom, where do we go next holiday?
lines.style: eager small child voice, bright warm bouncing delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 神様にお参りに、行きましょうか。
lines.en: Shall we go pray to the gods?
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 隣の女の子も、誘っていい?
lines.en: Can I invite the girl next door?
lines.style: hopeful small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いいわよ。その女の子のママにも聞くわ。
lines.en: Sure. I'll ask that girl's mom too.
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 前に会った老人、また会えるかな?
lines.en: Will we meet that old man again?
lines.style: curious small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あの優しい老人ね。会えるといいわね。
lines.en: That kind old man. I hope we meet him.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 神様に、晴れますようにってお願いする!
lines.en: I'll wish the gods for sunny weather!
lines.style: cheerful small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 休日が、楽しみになってきたわね。
lines.en: The holiday is becoming something to look forward to.
lines.style: tender mother voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
